78193.subject: Onchain Assets Weekly: 8/28/26
78193.body:
Onchain Assets Weekly

Автор: Securitize


Автор: Securitize

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/onchain-assets-weekly-82826-securitize-8a9dc?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BewobsCe%2FRMKuA2G7dTDCbQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=3jw5C5gpziIIo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mtddow41~3l-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mtddow41-3l
  
This week’s highlights: Brett Redfearn joins The Block podcast; Carlos Domingo joins Talking Tokens Podcast; Securitize and CIG streamline onboarding; Currenc Capital partners with Securitize; and tokenized stocks reach $2.8B; and Billy Miller clarifies onchain ownership. The Block Securitize President: We Have A $400M War Chest At the SALT Conference, Securitize President Brett Redfearn explains that if the CLARITY Act doesn’t pass, how Securitize’s broker-dealer, transfer agent and ATS position the company to keep building within existing securities laws as policy evolves. WATCH NOW Talking Tokens Podcast How Tokenization Could Rebuild the Financial System CEO and Co-Founder Carlos Domingo joins Jacquelyn Melinek to discuss Securitize’s growth to $5B in tokenized AUM, arguing that tokenization remains early but resilient as infrastructure for onchain equities, IPO access, and RWA collateral develops. WATCH NOW Crypto Economy Securitize and Crypto Insights Group Partner to Streamline Digital Asset Onboarding The partnership aims to streamline onboarding for fund managers by reducing the duplicate information requests commonly encountered across the institutional ecosystem. READ MORE Investing.com Currenc Capital partners with Securitize on tokenization The partnership combines CURRENC Capital’s firsthand public-equity tokenization experience with Securitize’s regulated infrastructure to explore bringing shares onchain while preserving underlying security rights. READ MORE Cryptorank Tokenized Stock Market Surges to $2.8B as Institutional Adoption Accelerates Institutional interest is helping tokenized stock market move beyond $2.8 billion as investors seek more flexible access to traditional assets. READ MORE Be(In)Crypto The $37 Billion Tokenization Boom Has an Ownership Problem Securitize COO Billy Miller explains the distinction clearly: “In an issuer-sponsored model, the issuer authorizes tokenization with the token representing the actual security and ownership.” READ MORE
Продовжити читати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/onchain-assets-weekly-82826-securitize-8a9dc?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BewobsCe%2FRMKuA2G7dTDCbQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=3jw5C5gpziIIo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-newsletter_content_preview_text-0-readmore_button_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
